summary: The project uses jackc/pgx v5.9.2 which lacks the require_auth configuration option, allowing PostgreSQL to accept any auth method including no-password (CWE-306). The fix is available in pgx v5.10.0.
userImpact: PostgreSQL authentication can be bypassed if pgx v5.9.2 is not updated to v5.10.0, potentially allowing unauthorized database access.
rootCause: pgx v5.9.2 lacks the require_auth configuration option to enforce PostgreSQL authentication methods, allowing downgrade to weaker auth or no-password auth (CWE-306).
proposedFix: Upgrade pgx dependency from v5.9.2 to v5.10.0 using: go get -u github.com/jackc/pgx/v5@v5.10.0
keyQuote: pgx accepts ANY PostgreSQL auth method including no-password
